summary: BR Brain · Smart Paste privacy · iOS-style paste and password-manager presentation

changes.title: Intelligent paste
changes.detail: Local destination and intent ranking with original ordinary paste.

changes.title: Verification codes and password managers
changes.detail: Masked copied-code action only in recognized OTP fields, provider-owned Autofill with stable ordering and editor-generation checks.

changes.title: Private learning and fluid chips
changes.detail: Encrypted category-only feedback, reset control and 150ms capsule geometry motion; no new permissions.

changes.title: OTP credential safety
changes.detail: Card security and verification codes, CVV/CVC and recovery credentials are excluded from automatic OTP suggestions and clipboard history. Expanded regression tests.

changes.title: Centered paste previews
changes.detail: Flat regular-weight clipboard previews replace the prominent capsule fill. Dismiss by long-press; compact typing no longer displays a persistent paste icon.

changes.title: Chrome shortcut
changes.detail: Use the installed Chrome icon without a text label, with a right-edge reveal and the existing copy-age limit and click-only local URL cleaning. The system clipboard is not rewritten.

changes.title: Password manager presentation
changes.detail: Request transparent inline autofill chip backgrounds, larger readable text and centered layout while preserving genuine Android provider-owned content, actions and editor-generation checks.
